data.name: Lalit
data.gender_notes: Lalit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: 1. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'lalitam', meaning 'skillful'. 2. In Hindu mythology, Lalit is an aspect of Vishnu, representing the power of creativity and artistry. 3. The name is also associated with the god of love, Kamadeva, and is believed to bring beauty and charm. The name Lalit carries the meaning “Elegant, Graceful, Skilled” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lalit usually hope their child will grow to embody elegant, graceful, skilled and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the creative power of the universe and the inner artist in all of us.
data.etymology: Lalit belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elegant, Graceful, Skilled.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lalit total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Lalit holds cultural significance as it is derived from the Sanskrit word 'lalitam', which means 'skillful'. This suggests that a person named Lalit is believed to be talented, artistic, and creative. In ancient Indian texts, Lalit is mentioned as a name of Vishnu, representing his power of creativity and artistry. The name is also related to love and beauty, as it is associated with Kamadeva, the god of love in Hindu mythology.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Lalit lies in its association with the Hindu deity Vishnu. Lalit represents the divine power of creativity and artistry, and is believed to inspire and empower individuals to express their inner talents and skills in the world. Additionally, the name's connection to Kamadeva suggests a deep appreciation for the beauty and charm of life, and a reminder to enjoy and cherish the present moment. Overall, the name Lalit serves as a reminder of the divine inspiration and creativity within each of us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Lalit, meaning 'playful' or 'graceful', symbolizes the free-flowing, joyful expression of divine consciousness. It embodies the idea of life as a dance, inviting us to embrace the beauty and wonder of each moment.
